title: Garrison / Models and tokens
description: Token usage, cost, throughput, and latency by served model, as reported by harnesses on the control plane and on workers.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Served model as the harness reported it; none when it did not report one.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens consumed by finished runs in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Input tokens in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="input", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Output tokens in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="output", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Cached tokens
panels.description: Cached input tokens in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="cached", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Reasoning tokens
panels.description: Reasoning or thinking tokens in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="reasoning", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Cost (USD)
panels.description: Reported or estimated cost in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Tokens by model and direction (per minute)
panels.description: Token rate per model and direction.

targets.expr: sum by (model, direction) (rate(garrison_run_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tokens per run by model and direction (p50, p95)
panels.description: Per-run token distribution from the garrison_harness_tokens histogram.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, direction) (rate(garrison_harness_tokens_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model, direction) (rate(garrison_harness_tokens_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cost by model (USD per hour)
panels.description: Cost per hour by served model.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (rate(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])) * 3600 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cost by model and agent (USD per hour)
panels.description: Cost per hour by model and agent.

targets.expr: sum by (model, agent) (rate(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])) * 3600 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cost per run by model (p50, p95)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_cost_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_cost_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Output tokens per second by model
panels.description: Output rate percentiles over the streaming window (runs with at least 100 ms of streaming).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_output_rate_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_output_rate_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Time to first token by model
panels.description: Harness start to first model output, by model.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Streaming time by model
panels.description: First to last model output, by model.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="streaming", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="streaming", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Worker-reported tokens by model and direction (per minute)
panels.description: Tokens counted on the workers that ran the harness. Matches the control-plane counters unless completions were lost.

targets.expr: sum by (model, direction) (rate(garrison_worker_harness_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Worker-reported cost by model (USD per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (model) (rate(garrison_worker_harness_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])) * 3600 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "model", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Model summary
panels.description: Per-model totals over the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum by (model) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
round(sum by (model) (increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="input", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
round(sum by (model) (increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{direction="output", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
sum by (model) (increase(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))
